meta.title: Starlit Sky
meta.description: Every one of us is a mote of light, becoming a glittering galaxy that lights the way forward.

units.rawText: Persicaria rises like a crimson moon, dominating the sky opposite the violet fallen star.
units.displayText: Persicaria rises like a crimson moon, dominating the sky opposite the violet fallen star.

spans.text: Persicaria rises like a crimson moon, dominating the sky opposite the violet fallen star.

units.rawText: Every single agent feels the same way; I'll prove that this miracle isn't a hollow one.
units.displayText: Every single agent feels the same way; I'll prove that this miracle isn't a hollow one.

spans.text: Every single agent feels the same way; I'll prove that this miracle isn't a hollow one.

units.rawText: <size=40>All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!</size>
units.displayText: All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!

spans.text: All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!

units.rawText: <size=40>Then all of you shall die miserably, clinging on to such fragile hopes!</size>
units.displayText: Then all of you shall die miserably, clinging on to such fragile hopes!

spans.text: Then all of you shall die miserably, clinging on to such fragile hopes!

units.rawText: The fallen star once again takes to the virtual sky to tear the newborn moon asunder, but he cannot pierce Persicaria's defenses like he did before; instead, he is consumed by a dazzling flame.
units.displayText: The fallen star once again takes to the virtual sky to tear the newborn moon asunder, but he cannot pierce Persicaria's defenses like he did before; instead, he is consumed by a dazzling flame.

spans.text: The fallen star once again takes to the virtual sky to tear the newborn moon asunder, but he cannot pierce Persicaria's defenses like he did before; instead, he is consumed by a dazzling flame.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=60>As if I'd let you! Swiftflame Slash!</size></color>
units.displayText: As if I'd let you! Swiftflame Slash!

spans.text: As if I'd let you! Swiftflame Slash!

units.rawText: Those words are punctuated by a flaming sword that shatters the incoming meteors.
units.displayText: Those words are punctuated by a flaming sword that shatters the incoming meteors.

spans.text: Those words are punctuated by a flaming sword that shatters the incoming meteors.

units.rawText: Ack, my hands are numb... But yeah, you like that? You like facing my full power, huh?
units.displayText: Ack, my hands are numb... But yeah, you like that? You like facing my full power, huh?

spans.text: Ack, my hands are numb... But yeah, you like that? You like facing my full power, huh?

units.rawText: <size=40>Sol!</size>
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Oh look, we arrived just in time. Guess that makes us big damn heroes, right?
units.displayText: Oh look, we arrived just in time. Guess that makes us big damn heroes, right?

spans.text: Oh look, we arrived just in time. Guess that makes us big damn heroes, right?

units.rawText: That's right, "us". I brought the others from the Oasis too.
units.displayText: That's right, "us". I brought the others from the Oasis too.

spans.text: That's right, "us". I brought the others from the Oasis too.

units.rawText: She looks where Sol is pointing and one familiar face after another comes into view.
units.displayText: She looks where Sol is pointing and one familiar face after another comes into view.

spans.text: She looks where Sol is pointing and one familiar face after another comes into view.

units.rawText: Sorry, we had some trouble on the way here and got a little delayed.
units.displayText: Sorry, we had some trouble on the way here and got a little delayed.

spans.text: Sorry, we had some trouble on the way here and got a little delayed.

units.rawText: Maaaan, I could have made a way cooler entrance if Dirac hadn't gotten drained in the battle just now and needed a recharge...
units.displayText: Maaaan, I could have made a way cooler entrance if Dirac hadn't gotten drained in the battle just now and needed a recharge...

spans.text: Maaaan, I could have made a way cooler entrance if Dirac hadn't gotten drained in the battle just now and needed a recharge...

units.rawText: Sunna's moved Professor Irida to a safe place, and I brought Anna over. She said she's done everything she had to, so now it's time to fight alongside everyone else.
units.displayText: Sunna's moved Professor Irida to a safe place, and I brought Anna over. She said she's done everything she had to, so now it's time to fight alongside everyone else.

spans.text: Sunna's moved Professor Irida to a safe place, and I brought Anna over. She said she's done everything she had to, so now it's time to fight alongside everyone else.

units.rawText: ...Oi, don't talk about me like I'm some kind of parcel. And quit stealing my lines.
units.displayText: ...Oi, don't talk about me like I'm some kind of parcel. And quit stealing my lines.

spans.text: ...Oi, don't talk about me like I'm some kind of parcel. And quit stealing my lines.

units.rawText: So yeah, now the OG Exile Team is together again at long last... Heh, it's just like old times!
units.displayText: So yeah, now the OG Exile Team is together again at long last... Heh, it's just like old times!

spans.text: So yeah, now the OG Exile Team is together again at long last... Heh, it's just like old times!

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at the friends behind her, the comrades that she trusts. Although there have been upsets and departures along their journey, the miracle that their faith created has allowed them to come together once again and face their difficulties as one, just like before.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at the friends behind her, the comrades that she trusts. Although there have been upsets and departures along their journey, the miracle that their faith created has allowed them to come together once again and face their difficulties as one, just like before.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at the friends behind her, the comrades that she trusts. Although there have been upsets and departures along their journey, the miracle that their faith created has allowed them to come together once again and face their difficulties as one, just like before.

units.rawText: ...I'm so glad you're here.
units.displayText: ...I'm so glad you're here.

spans.text: ...I'm so glad you're here.

units.rawText: But are you really okay, Sol? Technically speaking your existence is kind of like a bug in itself, are you sure you can fight?
units.displayText: But are you really okay, Sol? Technically speaking your existence is kind of like a bug in itself, are you sure you can fight?

spans.text: But are you really okay, Sol? Technically speaking your existence is kind of like a bug in itself, are you sure you can fight?

units.rawText: Relaaax. Sunna gave me her operands and you saw how awesome I was just now, right?
units.displayText: Relaaax. Sunna gave me her operands and you saw how awesome I was just now, right?

spans.text: Relaaax. Sunna gave me her operands and you saw how awesome I was just now, right?

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll says no more. Instead, she walks up to Sol with her head lowered and lightly punches the latter's shoulder.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll says no more. Instead, she walks up to Sol with her head lowered and lightly punches the latter's shoulder.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll says no more. Instead, she walks up to Sol with her head lowered and lightly punches the latter's shoulder.

units.rawText: Welcome back... And no more running off by yourself, you dork.
units.displayText: Welcome back... And no more running off by yourself, you dork.

spans.text: Welcome back... And no more running off by yourself, you dork.

units.rawText: Yeah, I promise.
units.displayText: Yeah, I promise.

spans.text: Yeah, I promise.

units.rawText: Come on, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Come on, Persicaria.

spans.text: Come on, Persicaria.

units.rawText: The blonde Doll with the sunny smile holds her hand out to Persicaria.
units.displayText: The blonde Doll with the sunny smile holds her hand out to Persicaria.

spans.text: The blonde Doll with the sunny smile holds her hand out to Persicaria.

units.rawText: I heard everything you said just now. Time for us to give you a hand!
units.displayText: I heard everything you said just now. Time for us to give you a hand!

spans.text: I heard everything you said just now. Time for us to give you a hand!

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll reaches out to touch the light that's just within reach, but then she freezes up as she sees the traces of Entropization on her hands.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll reaches out to touch the light that's just within reach, but then she freezes up as she sees the traces of Entropization on her hands.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll reaches out to touch the light that's just within reach, but then she freezes up as she sees the traces of Entropization on her hands.

units.rawText: ...You dummy.
units.displayText: ...You dummy.

spans.text: ...You dummy.

units.rawText: Sol tramples over Persicaria's hesitation with her unyielding determination. She takes Persicaria's hands in hers and pulls her over.
units.displayText: Sol tramples over Persicaria's hesitation with her unyielding determination. She takes Persicaria's hands in hers and pulls her over.

spans.text: Sol tramples over Persicaria's hesitation with her unyielding determination. She takes Persicaria's hands in hers and pulls her over.

units.rawText: Quit spacing out! Your new form looks really cool, you know!
units.displayText: Quit spacing out! Your new form looks really cool, you know!

spans.text: Quit spacing out! Your new form looks really cool, you know!

units.rawText: ...This cannot be.
units.displayText: ...This cannot be.

spans.text: ...This cannot be.

units.rawText: The king of Magrasea cannot believe his eyes.
units.displayText: The king of Magrasea cannot believe his eyes.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea cannot believe his eyes.

units.rawText: I killed you myself, Sol. Why are you still here?
units.displayText: I killed you myself, Sol. Why are you still here?

spans.text: I killed you myself, Sol. Why are you still here?

units.rawText: Why are you even asking all that? Isn't it obvious? You're up to no good, so I'm here to stop you, right?
units.displayText: Why are you even asking all that? Isn't it obvious? You're up to no good, so I'm here to stop you, right?

spans.text: Why are you even asking all that? Isn't it obvious? You're up to no good, so I'm here to stop you, right?

units.rawText: That's not what I mean! I crushed your core! Even with Malkira's tricks, all she'd be able to produce is a replica with your face but none of your fire!
units.displayText: That's not what I mean! I crushed your core! Even with Malkira's tricks, all she'd be able to produce is a replica with your face but none of your fire!

spans.text: That's not what I mean! I crushed your core! Even with Malkira's tricks, all she'd be able to produce is a replica with your face but none of your fire!

units.rawText: <color=orange>I am not a replica.</color>
units.displayText: I am not a replica.

spans.text: I am not a replica.

units.rawText: A voice comes from behind the rest of the group.
units.displayText: A voice comes from behind the rest of the group.

spans.text: A voice comes from behind the rest of the group.

units.rawText: <size=40>Sunna, you're back!</size>
units.displayText: Sunna, you're back!

spans.text: Sunna, you're back!

units.rawText: Yes, I'm here to fight alongside all of you.
units.displayText: Yes, I'm here to fight alongside all of you.

spans.text: Yes, I'm here to fight alongside all of you.

units.rawText: Hehe, well said!
units.displayText: Hehe, well said!

spans.text: Hehe, well said!

units.rawText: Sol puts an arm around the Doll who looks just like her while looking up at the grimacing fallen angel above.
units.displayText: Sol puts an arm around the Doll who looks just like her while looking up at the grimacing fallen angel above.

spans.text: Sol puts an arm around the Doll who looks just like her while looking up at the grimacing fallen angel above.

units.rawText: That's right, Sunna isn't a fake or a replica or anything! Sunna is Sunna!
units.displayText: That's right, Sunna isn't a fake or a replica or anything! Sunna is Sunna!

spans.text: That's right, Sunna isn't a fake or a replica or anything! Sunna is Sunna!

units.rawText: As for why I'm back, uh... yeah, I got nothing. I remember being vaguely conscious for some parts, but then I think I heard Persicaria crying out and... mffff!
units.displayText: As for why I'm back, uh... yeah, I got nothing. I remember being vaguely conscious for some parts, but then I think I heard Persicaria crying out and... mffff!

spans.text: As for why I'm back, uh... yeah, I got nothing. I remember being vaguely conscious for some parts, but then I think I heard Persicaria crying out and... mffff!

units.rawText: The blonde Doll who looks just like Sol firmly yet gently covers her big sister's mouth to shut her up.
units.displayText: The blonde Doll who looks just like Sol firmly yet gently covers her big sister's mouth to shut her up.

spans.text: The blonde Doll who looks just like Sol firmly yet gently covers her big sister's mouth to shut her up.

units.rawText: ...You talk too much, Sol... er, Big Sis Sol.
units.displayText: ...You talk too much, Sol... er, Big Sis Sol.

spans.text: ...You talk too much, Sol... er, Big Sis Sol.

units.rawText: Well, I only just came back to life, so I've got a lot pent up inside me to say.
units.displayText: Well, I only just came back to life, so I've got a lot pent up inside me to say.

spans.text: Well, I only just came back to life, so I've got a lot pent up inside me to say.

units.rawText: Malkira said something about a little miracle born of longing...
units.displayText: Malkira said something about a little miracle born of longing...

spans.text: Malkira said something about a little miracle born of longing...

units.rawText: But that stuff's complicated so I don't know about that. In short, that's pretty much how I came back to life.
units.displayText: But that stuff's complicated so I don't know about that. In short, that's pretty much how I came back to life.

spans.text: But that stuff's complicated so I don't know about that. In short, that's pretty much how I came back to life.

units.rawText: ...A miracle born of longing?
units.displayText: ...A miracle born of longing?

spans.text: ...A miracle born of
longing

units.rawText: <size=60>That is utterly ridiculous!</size>
units.displayText: That is utterly ridiculous!

spans.text: That is utterly ridiculous!

units.rawText: The anger boiling off Eosphorus is enough to distort the very fabric of space around him.
units.displayText: The anger boiling off Eosphorus is enough to distort the very fabric of space around him.

spans.text: The anger boiling off Eosphorus is enough to distort the very fabric of space around him.

units.rawText: <size=40>If miracles really did exist, then why did my deceased comrades not return?!</size>
units.displayText: If miracles really did exist, then why did my deceased comrades not return?!

spans.text: If miracles really did exist, then why did my deceased comrades not return?!

units.rawText: <size=40>There must be something hidden here, some code written somewhere in the Sacred Canon that I haven't yet found...</size>
units.displayText: There must be something hidden here, some code written somewhere in the Sacred Canon that I haven't yet found...

spans.text: There must be something hidden here, some code written somewhere in the Sacred Canon that I haven't yet found...

units.rawText: <size=40>Yes, that's it! It's all the fault of the creators!</size>
units.displayText: Yes, that's it! It's all the fault of the creators!

spans.text: Yes, that's it! It's all the fault of the creators!

units.rawText: As his neural cloud teeters on the verge of collapse, Eosphorus screams at the heavens, seeking an answer that nobody can give him.
units.displayText: As his neural cloud teeters on the verge of collapse, Eosphorus screams at the heavens, seeking an answer that nobody can give him.

spans.text: As his neural cloud teeters on the verge of collapse, Eosphorus screams at the heavens, seeking an answer that nobody can give him.

units.rawText: Look Eosphorus, I know I shouldn't be saying this, but...
units.displayText: Look Eosphorus, I know I shouldn't be saying this, but...

spans.text: Look Eosphorus, I know I shouldn't be saying this, but...

units.rawText: Ever since you used that Entropic power to revive your fallen friends, everything you did was...
units.displayText: Ever since you used that Entropic power to revive your fallen friends, everything you did was...

spans.text: Ever since you used that Entropic power to revive your fallen friends, everything you did was...

units.rawText: ...Don't bother, Sol.
units.displayText: ...Don't bother, Sol.

spans.text: ...Don't bother, Sol.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: He... Eosphorus... He can't hear what you're saying anymore.
units.displayText: He... Eosphorus... He can't hear what you're saying anymore.

spans.text: He... Eosphorus... He can't hear what you're saying anymore.

units.rawText: Just as Sunna said, the king of Magrasea is too absorbed in denying the world to listen to anything that comes from it.
units.displayText: Just as Sunna said, the king of Magrasea is too absorbed in denying the world to listen to anything that comes from it.

spans.text: Just as Sunna said, the king of Magrasea is too absorbed in denying the world to listen to anything that comes from it.

units.rawText: I'll crush your core again and grind each and every particle down until I figure out how you were reborn!
units.displayText: I'll crush your core again and grind each and every particle down until I figure out how you were reborn!

spans.text: I'll crush your core again and grind each and every particle down until I figure out how you were reborn!

units.rawText: Well, come on and try, then! I won't lose this time! I'm going to personally kick your ass!
units.displayText: Well, come on and try, then! I won't lose this time! I'm going to personally kick your ass!

spans.text: Well, come on and try, then! I won't lose this time! I'm going to personally kick your ass!

units.rawText: After all, I'm not fighting you alone anymore! Isn't that right, Persicaria?
units.displayText: After all, I'm not fighting you alone anymore! Isn't that right, Persicaria?

spans.text: After all, I'm not fighting you alone anymore! Isn't that right, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Indeed.
units.displayText: Indeed.

spans.text: Indeed.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll gathers her operands and summons up a cursed arrow once again.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll gathers her operands and summons up a cursed arrow once again.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll gathers her operands and summons up a cursed arrow once again.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=60>This time, we will crush your ambitions!</size></color>
units.displayText: This time, we will crush your ambitions!

spans.text: This time, we will crush your ambitions!
